adaptations.effect: Use /etc/zsh and update documentation references from /etc/z* to /etc/zsh/z*.
Replace direct root installation with DESTDIR staging, immutable admission, and later projection.
Treat /etc/shells as shared resolved state instead of package-owned append-only state.
Exclude generated /usr/share/info/dir from package ownership; packages contribute Info documents and a resolver owns the shared registry.
Set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1783881773 from the canonical source release so Groff documentation does not embed wall-clock build time.
Do not change root's login shell, /bin/sh, or SSH authentication policy.
